PolyCup

By Kiki · Simple Cup for PolyTrack 0.6.3

Join, choose one track, and race together. Any 2–8 racers can start. Reach 100 points, then win a later round to win the Cup.

  • No seeding, captain draft, semifinals or full-grid requirement.
  • Each racer picks one official, community or locally saved custom track. Shared picks count once; the order is shuffled.
  • Automatic rounds, finalist scoring, warmups and track rotation.
  • Clear race standings, green point gains, finalist markers and car-skin previews.
  • Overall WR, scored Cup session record (TR), and the watched racer’s overall PB.
  • Switchable racer POV with a 250 ms camera and car buffer.
  • Organizer controls for DNF, void, undo, reconnect and results export.

Press F8 in a native multiplayer room. Everyone needs version 0.2.0. The organizer stays connected; no separate tournament server is required. Native room capacity includes spectators.

PBs are reported by players’ mods; records need the game’s own profile or leaderboard service. New save format; older bracket saves cannot resume in Simple Cup. See the repository README for validation and limits.

Independent community mod. Not affiliated with Kodub, Trackmania, Ubisoft or PolyModLoader.
